text:
Alex: CI red on gpu-smoke (job 4821) running on h100-canary. Failing with 'invalid device function' right after CUDA init. Quick excerpt from the job log:
```
[ERROR] cuInit: driver version 12020 != kernel 12030
E invalid device function at aten_cuda.cpp:123
```
Anyone seen this crop up after the container/os bump? cc @Maria @Sam

ci-bot: Job gpu-smoke/4821 failed on h100-rc-3. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/4821/logs

Maria: Ack. Which runtime image/artifact is this using? Was this on pinned or canary?

Alex: Using `redwood/gpu-runtime:2026-03-16-cuda12.2` (canary). Reproduces locally on our h100 lab box. Not an OOM — fails during kernel launch.

Sam: Sounds like driver/toolkit mismatch or bad PTX. Quick checks: collect `nvidia-smi -a`, dmesg, and try a rerun with `CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER`. Also try a pinned driver image.

Raj: I can bisect. Plan: rerun with pinned driver image and with current canary image, plus one older driver to narrow the roll that introduced regression. Also request `--collect-dmesg=true` on reruns so we capture kernel messages.

Alex: Kicking off reruns now:
```
CI_OVERRIDE_IMAGE=redwood/gpu-runtime:2026-02-10-driver-pinned 
./scripts/ci_rerun.sh gpu-smoke 4821 --env CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER --collect-dmesg=true
```
I'll attach logs when done.

Maria: Add `--annotate=nvcc-version` so we know toolkit version in the run metadata. If we see Xid or NVRM errors in dmesg, that's a kernel/driver mismatch.

ci-bot: Rerun started by Alex: new run 4826 (pinned-driver) -> tracker: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/4826

Alex: Rerun 4826 failed almost immediately with the same 'invalid device function'. dmesg from node shows repeated entries: `NVRM: GPU at pci:0000:00:1a: GPU reports an unsupported ptx instruction` during module init.

Sam: That points to PTX/compute capability mismatch — not just a small driver ABI bump. Can you try building with CUDA_TOOLKIT=12.1 (or disallow JIT/PTX fallback) to see if older ptx is compatible? Also capture `nvdisasm` for the kernel symbol if possible.

Raj: I'm going to queue a bisect across the last 3 driver rollouts and the kernel module build commits (including D1234 which changed module flags). Can someone grant me SSH to the h100-canary node so I can run `nvcc --ptxas-options=-v` and `modinfo nvidia`? If not, I can spin up a debug job with the same node image.

Alex: Granting access to Raj now. Uploading full tarball of logs and artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/4821-4826.tar.gz

Maria: Quick note — if this reproduces on h100 but not on our a100 lanes, that's consistent with a PTX/ptxas change. Prior rollback PR touched kernel module compile flags which could affect PTX compatibility.

Sam: If bisect points to kernel module or PTX generation changes, we should either rebuild modules with legacy PTX support or pin drivers until we can cut a proper fix. I'll draft a rollback PR ready to go once we confirm.

Raj: Bisect queued; running now. Will report back with the earliest bad driver/kernel commit and attach dmesg/nvdisasm in ~30 minutes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
